format::Meta:
/// Interpretation of a chunk's metadata bytes. Holds no data of its own:
/// header fields are decoded once, sections are borrowed.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct Meta<'a> {
    model_key: u64,
    renumbered: bool,
    n_cells: u32,
    n_dims: u32,
    value_width: usize,
    max_lanes: u32,
    lane_min: u32,
    page_log2: u32,
    max_k: u32,
    max_nnz: u32,
    max_elems: u32,
    nnz_total: u64,
    meta_len: usize,
    records_start: usize,
    records_len: u64,
    models: &'a [u8],
    dims: &'a [u8],
    modes: Option<&'a [u8]>,
    offsets: &'a [u8],
    lengths: &'a [u8],
    kinds: &'a [u8],
    nnz: &'a [u8],
}
store::CpkWriter:
/// Writes one matrix to a `.cpk` file. Rows are appended in order; the file
/// is valid only after [`CpkWriter::finish`].
pub struct CpkWriter {
    file: File,
    options: CpkOptions,
    dtype: Dtype,
    source: SourceLayout,
    n_cols: u32,
    offset: u64,
    entries: Vec<ChunkEntry>,
    staged: Staged,
    buffers: Buffers,
    threads: usize,
}
